exposure: presence of mould or moisture in the mother's home before pregnancy
presence of flies or mosquitoes in the dwelling currently
pets kept in the child's home currently
presence of pets during child's first year
ethnicity other than the Han Chinese
cohort: 8153 parents of children aged 2-8 years in Urumqi city
finding: Risk factors for eczema in preschool children in Urumqi include caesarean section, being an only child, exposure to mould, flies, mosquitoes, and pets, and family history of eczema, while being of ethnicity other than Han Chinese was protective.
